model: Nintendo Switch dock with LAN port

sources.quote: USB端子（側面×２[USB2.0対応]） 本体接続端子 ACアダプター接続端子 HDMI端子 LAN端子
「Nintendo Switch（有機ELモデル）」に付属のドックには、2つのUSB端子とテレビに接続するためのHDMI端子に加え、新たに有線LAN端子も搭載。
「Nintendo Switch（有機ELモデル）」のドックは、「Nintendo Switch」でも使えますか？ 有線LAN端子も含めて、お使いいただけます。

notes: The dock with a wired LAN port (Nintendo Japan spec modal dock_oled, linked from the Nintendo Switch (OLED model) page). Axis map as the original dock: width=175 (横), height=104 (縦), depth=50.7 (厚さ). Nintendo of America's tech-specs page gives the same dock in inches only ('Approximately 4.1 inches high, 6.9 inches long, and 2.0 inches deep', '.69 lbs'), consistent and not used.

host_console: Nintendo's OLED-model page says this dock ships with the Nintendo Switch (OLED model), and its FAQ says the OLED-model dock also works with the original Nintendo Switch, LAN port included. ports is Nintendo's complete list: two side USB ports only (no rear USB), plus LAN.
